rows.quote: The osteoporosis fracture GWAS data (osteoporosis with pathological fracture) originates from the FinnGen (r10).
rows.coder_note: The sentence writes the release as 'FinnGen (r10)', R10 in another case (rule A); the data availability statement gives r10.finngen.fi; the 1822 cases and 311,210 controls are endpoint counts and no other release is named.

The abstract passage names the NHGRI-EBI Catalog and the FinnGen consortium together as sources of summary statistics, with no accession and no statement of which dataset came from the Catalog; a repository name alone identifies no dataset.
